# Alejandro Nicolau, Private Chef

> Alejandro Nicolau is a London-based private chef trained in San Sebastian under Martin Berasategui (3 Michelin stars). He cooks bespoke menus in private residences, aboard yachts and at corporate and international events across London and the United Kingdom, with his own team of chefs, bartenders and waiters. Prices are always quoted per event after an enquiry; there is no fixed rate card.

Key facts: based in London, UK; Spanish heritage and Mediterranean-led cooking, plus Italian, French, Asian, South American, Middle Eastern and plant-based menus; services include dinner parties, extended stays, yacht chef, paella catering, bar and cocktail service, gala dinners, corporate events and weekly meal prep. To book: use the enquiry form at https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/contact.html (reply within 24 hours). Contact: bookingsalejandrochef@gmail.com, +44 7762 367969. Instagram: https://instagram.com/alejandro_private_chef

## Dietary menus
- [Kosher-style private chef London](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/kosher-style-private-chef.html): kosher-style menus (not certified kosher), no pork or shellfish, meat and dairy kept apart
- [Halal private chef London](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/halal-private-chef.html): halal-friendly menus, no pork, no alcohol in the cooking, halal-sourced meat on request
